summary: SecurityInsight now sets up its own database access, so nobody needs database admin rights for updates.

new.title: SecurityInsight sets up its own database access
new.text: A built-in setup job now creates and checks the database access the product needs. Every update runs it first; if it fails, your installed version keeps running.
new.action: For an existing installation, add the database setup job's identity to your SQL admin group once.

fixes.title: Support level applies in every database
fixes.text: The support level you set in the Invardia portal applies to all your SecurityInsight data.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Asset tagging gets its database access from the update, and two manual database scripts are no longer needed for Pro.
